dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. It's all thanks to you that Rana wakes up again...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'll be a good boy for grandma, the village chief, and Rana, from now on. I won't try to explore the dangerous places in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'll grow up to be a great man, and go look for Rana and Arana!
